prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I spent too much time on the last question.
I spent too much time at the last question.
I spend too much time on the last question yesterday.
answer: I spent too much time on the last question.

wrong.I spent too much time at the last questi: 「花時間在某件事上」要用 spend time on，不是 at；at 通常指地點或時間點。
wrong.I spend too much time on the last questi: yesterday 表示過去，動詞要用過去式 spent，不能用現在式 spend。

why: spend time on + 事物 表示把時間花在某事上；yesterday 搭配過去式 spent。
tip: 花時間在某事上：spend time on。
say: I spent too much time on the last question.

prompt: 考完試後，你想告訴同學：你看完題目才發現自己把題號看錯了。哪一句最合適？
options: I read the wrong question number.
I read the question wrongly number.
I wrong read the number of question.
answer: I read the wrong question number.

wrongly 是副詞，不能放在名詞 number 前面修飾它；要用形容詞 wrong。
wrong 是形容詞，不能直接修飾動詞 read；而且 the number of question 少了複數 questions，語順也不自然。

why: wrong 當形容詞放在名詞前：the wrong question number，意思是看錯的題號。
tip: 形容詞放名詞前：the wrong number。
say: I read the wrong question number.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: I got this question wrong because I didn't read the sentence _____.
options: carefully
careful
care

wrong.careful: careful 是形容詞，這裡要修飾動詞 read，需要副詞 carefully。
wrong.care: care 是名詞或動詞（在乎），放在這裡文法不通順，不能修飾 read。

why: 修飾動詞 read 要用副詞，carefully 表示仔細地。
tip: 修飾動詞用副詞，形容詞 + ly。
say: I got this question wrong because I didn't read the sentence carefully.

text: I keep making the same mistake with prepositions.
options: 我一直在介系詞上犯同樣的錯。
我很喜歡練習介系詞。
我昨天第一次學到介系詞。
answer: 我一直在介系詞上犯同樣的錯。

wrong.我很喜歡練習介系詞。: 句中是 make the same mistake（犯錯），沒有表達喜歡練習的意思。
wrong.我昨天第一次學到介系詞。: keep making 表示一直重複，不是第一次學；句中也沒有 yesterday。

why: keep + V-ing 表示一再重複；the same mistake 是同樣的錯誤。
say: I keep making the same mistake with prepositions.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I check my wrong answers every weekend.
I checking my wrong answers every weekend.
I checks my wrong answers every weekend.
answer: I check my wrong answers every weekend.

wrong.I checking my wrong answers every weeken: 只有 checking 沒有 be 動詞，不能當句子的動詞；every weekend 也表示習慣，用現在簡單式。
主詞 I 搭配原形動詞 check，-s 是第三人稱單數才加。

why: every weekend 表示習慣，主詞 I 用原形動詞 check。
tip: 主詞是 I，現在式動詞不加 s。
say: I check my wrong answers every weekend.

prompt: 老師問你為什麼閱讀題錯很多。你想說：因為我沒有注意到關鍵字。哪一句最好？
options: I didn't notice the key words in the passage.
I didn't noticed the key words in the passage.
I no notice the key words in the passage.
answer: I didn't notice the key words in the passage.

wrong.I didn't noticed the key words in the pa: didn't 後面要接原形動詞，不能再用過去式 noticed。
wrong.I no notice the key words in the passage: 一般動詞的否定要用 don't／didn't，不能用 no 直接放在動詞前面。

why: 過去式否定用 didn't + 原形動詞；notice 是原形。
say: I didn't notice the key words in the passage.

prompt: 選出最適合的字，完成錯題整理的句子。
text: I write down my mistakes _____ I can review them tomorrow.
options: so that
because of
although

wrong.because of: because of 後面要接名詞，不能接完整句子 I can review them。
wrong.although: although 表示「雖然」，語意是轉折，但這裡要表達「為了能夠」的目的。

why: so that 引導目的，意思是「以便……」，後面接完整子句。
tip: 表示目的、以便：so that + 子句。
say: I write down my mistakes so that I can review them tomorrow.

prompt: 這段話中，Amy 的主要問題是什麼？
text: Amy knew the words in the question. But she didn't check the time, so she had no time for the last page.
options: 她沒有控制好時間。
她不認識題目的單字。
她忘記帶筆。

wrong.她不認識題目的單字。: 文中說 Amy knew the words，她是認識單字的。
wrong.她忘記帶筆。: 文中完全沒有提到筆，錯誤原因是沒檢查時間。

why: But she didn't check the time 說明問題在時間管理，所以最後一頁沒時間寫。
tip: But 後面常是重點，先找轉折。
say: She didn't check the time, so she had no time for the last page.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Read the question first, and then choose the answer.
Read the question first, and then chooses the answer.
Reading the question first, and then choose the answer.
answer: Read the question first, and then choose the answer.

wrong.Read the question first, and then choose: 這是祈使句，兩個動作都用原形動詞，chooses 不對。
wrong.Reading the question first, and then cho: 祈使句要用原形動詞開頭，Reading 變成動名詞，句子結構亂掉。

why: 建議、指示的祈使句，用原形動詞，前後動作用 and then 連接。
tip: 下指令用原形動詞，不加 s。
say: Read the question first, and then choose the answer.

prompt: 朋友問你怎麼準備會考英文。你想說：我每天花十分鐘複習前一天的錯題。哪一句最好？
options: I spend ten minutes reviewing yesterday's mistakes every day.
I spend ten minutes to review yesterday mistakes every days.
I am spending ten minute reviewing mistakes of yesterday every day.
answer: I spend ten minutes reviewing yesterday's mistakes every day.

wrong.I spend ten minutes to review yesterday: spend time 後面接 V-ing；every day 的 day 不加 s，yesterday 所有格要寫 yesterday's。
wrong.I am spending ten minute reviewing mista: ten minutes 要用複數；every day 是習慣，用現在簡單式比現在進行式自然。

why: spend + 時間 + V-ing 表示花時間做某事，every day 表示習慣。
tip: spend 時間 + V-ing，every day 不加 s。
say: I spend ten minutes reviewing yesterday's mistakes every day.

prompt: This is a careless mistake. 最接近哪個意思？
options: 這是因為不小心造成的錯誤。
這是一個很難的錯誤。
這是老師故意設計的錯誤。
answer: 這是因為不小心造成的錯誤。

wrong.這是一個很難的錯誤。: careless 是粗心的，不是困難；難的錯誤要用 difficult。
wrong.這是老師故意設計的錯誤。: careless 描述做事不小心，沒有老師故意設計的意思。

why: careless = care + less，沒有專心，所以是粗心造成的錯誤。
